The '''Mark II assault droids''' were [[Training droid/Legends|training droids]] used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Liam Dentiri]] to test the physical capabilities of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Description==
The Mark II assault [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had [[Color/Legends|brown-colored]] plating with yellow stripes, as well as yellow [[Photoreceptor/Legends|sensors]]. Each droid carried a single [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] for use in combat. Used as [[Training droid/Legends|training droids]], the Mark II was an upgraded version of the [[Mark I training droid]]s, while the [[Mark III training droid|Mark III]] and [[Mark IV training droid|Mark IV]] training droids improved upon the Mark II design.<ref name="CL2" />

==History==
The [[Battle droid/Legends|assault droids]] were used for training by elements of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy-conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="CL2" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> the [[Jedi instructor]] [[Liam Dentiri]] used them to test the combat abilities of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The test consisted of the Padawans activating a console within the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] courtyard, which summoned a single Mark II assault droid that would proceed to attack the Padawan. In order to pass the test, the Padawan had to defeat the droid.<ref name="CL2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mark II assault droid appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The droid model is featured in the "Combat Leadership: Mark II" optional side quest, which is part of the "Combat Leadership" series available only to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Jedi Consular]] classes on Tython. Although its name makes the droid unique, the model used for the Mark II assault droid is the same one used for various other droid models in the game.<ref name="CL2" />
